arcane-artist.summary: Illusion magic that lifts an ally's spirits.

Cantrip.summary: Learn Minor Illusion, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Inspiring Magic.summary: On casting an Illusion spell, give Heroic Inspiration to an ally within 30 ft who sees you. Once per Long Rest.

arcane-eloquence.summary: A cutting tongue backed by magic.

Cantrip.summary: Learn Vicious Mockery, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Smooth Talker.summary: Add 1d4 to CHA (Deception, Intimidation or Persuasion) checks.

arcane-infiltrator.summary: Charm your way in and duck out of harm.

Cantrip.summary: Learn Friends, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Cunning Diversion.summary: Bonus Action: Dodge. PB times per Long Rest.

arcane-omens.summary: Glimpses of what's coming help you and allies resist harm.

Cantrip.summary: Learn Guidance, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Helpful Premonition.summary: Reaction when you or a creature you see within 30 ft fails a save: add 1d4 to it, which may make it succeed. PB times per Long Rest.

arcane-overload.summary: Fire Bolt and a once-a-day jolt to evocation damage.

Cantrip.summary: Learn Fire Bolt, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Power Surge.summary: When an Evocation spell deals damage, add PB to one of its damage rolls. Once per Long Rest.

arcane-safeguard.summary: Protective magic you can spread quickly.

Cantrip.summary: Learn Resistance, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat); PB times per Long Rest you may cast it as a Bonus Action.

Sheltering Aid.summary: Helping an ally with an ability check also gives them Temporary HP equal to your PB.

arcane-undertaker.summary: Death magic and lore about the dead.

Cantrip.summary: Learn a Necromancy cantrip from the Cleric or Wizard list, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Knowledge from the Dead.summary: Add 1d4 to INT (History) and WIS (Medicine) checks.

Understanding of Death.summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration when you Help to stabilize a creature at 0 HP. Once per Long Rest.

familiar-friend.summary: A sturdier familiar that helps with your skills.

Faithful Companion.summary: Find Familiar always prepared, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat). Once per Long Rest cast it with no slot or Material components; your slots work too.

Fortified Familiar.summary: Your familiar gets extra max and current HP equal to twice your character level when summoned.

Helpful Friend.summary: Advantage on a check with a skill you're proficient in while your familiar is within 5 ft. PB times per Long Rest.

portal-jumper.summary: Touched by planar travel: resist otherworldly energy and blink short distances.

Otherworldly Resilience.summary: Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage (your pick).

Portal Step.summary: Spend 15 ft of movement to teleport up to 15 ft to an unoccupied space you see. Once per turn, PB times per Long Rest.

transmuted-anatomy.summary: A body reshaped by magic: faster and hard to alter.

Resilient Anatomy.summary: Advantage on saves against forced shape-changes. Reaction on a failed CON save: add 1d4, which may make it succeed; PB times per Long Rest.

abjuration-adept.summary: Abjuration specialist: extra warding spells and Temporary HP when you cast them.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Shield (1), Lesser Restoration (2), Protection from Energy (3), Banishment (4), Mass Cure Wounds (5).

Protective Ward.summary: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot gives you or a creature you see within 30 ft Temporary HP equal to twice the slot level.

conjuration-adept.summary: Conjuration specialist: extra summoning and travel spells, and steadier Concentration on them.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Entangle (1), Misty Step (2), Conjure Animals (3), Dimension Door (4), Conjure Elemental (5).

Persistent Conjuration.summary: Add the modifier of the ability you raised to CON saves for keeping Concentration on a Conjuration spell.

divination-adept.summary: Divination specialist: extra foresight spells and a reaction that tilts a roll.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Detect Evil and Good (1), Mind Spike (2), Clairvoyance (3), Divination (4), Scrying (5).

Prescient Intervention.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 60 ft makes a D20 Test: give it Advantage or Disadvantage. Once per Long Rest, or regained by casting a Divination spell with a slot.

uses.restore: casting a Divination spell with a spell slot

elemental-familiar.summary: Charge your familiar with elemental energy it can release in a burst.

Elemental Energy.summary: Each casting of Find Familiar, pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder; the familiar holds that energy until your next casting.

Elemental Resistance.summary: Your familiar resists the picked damage type.

Energy Pulse.summary: Bonus Action: your familiar within 120 ft uses its Reaction to burst; each creature in a 5-ft Emanation around it makes a DEX save or takes 2d4 of the picked type and, if Medium or smaller, falls Prone.

enchantment-adept.summary: Enchantment specialist: extra charm spells, cast without telltale components.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Dissonant Whispers (1), Enthrall (2), Hold Person (3), Dominate Beast (4), Modify Memory (5).

Subtle Enchantments.summary: Enchantment spells cast with a slot need no V, S or M components, except costly or consumed materials.

evocation-adept.summary: Evocation specialist: extra blasting spells, boosted by your own Hit Point Dice.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Chromatic Orb (1), Shatter (2), Fireball (3), Vitriolic Sphere (4), Wall of Force (5).

Fueled Evocation.summary: Once per turn when an Evocation spell deals damage, spend up to two Hit Point Dice and add their roll to one damage roll.

illusion-adept.summary: Illusion specialist: extra illusion spells that are silent and hard to see through.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Silent Image (1), Phantasmal Force (2), Major Image (3), Hallucinatory Terrain (4), Seeming (5).

Masterful Illusions.summary: Illusion spells cast with a slot need no V, S or M components, except costly or consumed materials. Investigation checks to see through your illusions have Disadvantage.

magic-connoisseur.summary: Builds on Magic Initiate with a level 1 and a level 2 spell.

Additional Spells.summary: Pick one level 1 and one level 2 spell off your Magic Initiate list; both are always prepared, and each is free once per Long Rest, or cast with your slots. Uses your Magic Initiate ability.

choices.note: level 1, from your Magic Initiate spell list
choices.label: Level 1 spell (free once per Long Rest)

choices.note: level 2, from your Magic Initiate spell list
choices.label: Level 2 spell (free once per Long Rest)

Spell Change.summary: On gaining a level, you may swap one of these spells for another of the same level from that list.

necromancy-adept.summary: Necromancy specialist: extra death spells that also mend you.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Inflict Wounds (1), Ray of Enfeeblement (2), Vampiric Touch (3), Blight (4), Raise Dead (5).

Life Manipulation.summary: Casting a Necromancy spell with a slot lets you spend up to two Hit Point Dice to heal their roll plus the slot level.

otherworldly-familiar.summary: Infuse your familiar with planar power so it resists harm and drifts through matter.

Otherworldly Power.summary: On casting Find Familiar you may empower the familiar until your next casting.

Energy Resistance.summary: The empowered familiar resists Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant or Thunder (your pick).

Phase Walk.summary: The empowered familiar moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; ending its turn in an object pushes it back to its last free space.

soothing-familiar.summary: Your familiar radiates healing that steadies allies' cures.

Healing Beacon.summary: While your familiar is within 120 ft, allies in a 5-ft Emanation around it count 1s and 2s on healing dice as 3s.

spell-resistant.summary: Hardened against magic and the energy it carries.

Magical Resilience.summary: Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant or Thunder damage (your pick).

Magic Resistant.summary: When about to fail a save against a spell or magic effect, add 1d6, which may make it succeed. PB times per Long Rest.

Shrouding Spells.summary: After casting a 1-action spell with a slot, Bonus Action: Dash and Hide. Uses equal to the raised ability's modifier per Long Rest.

Sneaky Casting.summary: While Invisible from Hide, Verbal components and spell attacks don't end it if you finish the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

transmutation-adept.summary: Transmutation specialist: extra shaping spells and a burst of speed when you cast them.

Additional Spells.summary: Always prepared once you have slots of their level: Jump (1), Spider Climb (2), Slow (3), Polymorph (4), Animate Objects (5).

Magical Augmentation.summary: Casting a Transmutation spell with a slot on your turn adds 5 ft × the slot level to your Speed until the turn ends.

warlike-familiar.summary: Turn your familiar into a fighter that guards those beside it.

Battle Familiar.summary: Battle Familiar always prepared; free once per Long Rest, or cast with your slots. Uses your Familiar Friend ability.

Intercept Attack.summary: When an attack roll hits a creature within 5 ft of your familiar, the familiar's Reaction adds your PB to that creature's AC against it, which may turn it into a miss.

arcane-warrior.summary: Fighting style: learn two Wizard cantrips (Mage Hand and Ray of Frost suggested), cast with INT, WIS or CHA; swap one for another Wizard cantrip on each level gained.

boon-of-erupting-spellpower.summary: Overcharge a damaging spell to hit harder and knock foes down.

Spell Overload.summary: On a damaging spell cast with a slot, count 1s and 2s on its damage dice as 3s, and everything it damaged is knocked Prone. Recharges on Initiative or a Short or Long Rest.

boon-of-magic-school-mastery.summary: Master one school of magic: a free level 1 spell at will and a signature spell up to level 7.

Mastered School.summary: Pick one of the eight schools; the next two benefits draw on it.

Rote Casting.summary: A level 1 spell of that school from your class list is always prepared and can be cast with no slot or components.

choices.note: level 1, of the mastered school, on your class's spell list
choices.label: Rote spell (at will)

Signature Arcanum.summary: A spell of that school of level 7 or lower is always prepared; free once per Long Rest, or cast with your slots.

choices.label: Signature spell (free once per Long Rest)

Repeatable.summary: Can be taken again for a different school.

boon-of-the-iron-mind.summary: Concentration that nothing short of collapse can break.

Unshakable Focus.summary: Damage and the like no longer break your Concentration; it ends only when you start another Concentration effect, are Petrified or Unconscious, or die.
